name: VPN Rotate
author: AlteringUX
description: Proton VPN free-tier connection with an IP rotator (protonvpn-rotate script); connects only over WiFi

barWidget.description: Shield icon showing Proton VPN state + exit country; click for connect / disconnect, rotate-now, and auto-rotate on a configurable interval; right-click to disconnect. Connect is gated on an active WiFi link.
